_note: 特殊句構未覆蓋 KP 補建：So/Such … that 倒裝（eng.t_sub.special.inversion-so-such，學測/分科級，較文學/正式）。為強調而把 So ＋ 形容詞/副詞 或 Such 置於句首時引發倒裝：So beautiful was the view that we stopped.（＝The view was so beautiful that…）／Such was his anger that he could not speak.（＝His anger was such that…）。鐵律：(1) So ＋ 形容詞置首後，動詞（通常 be）移到主詞前：So loud was the music that…；(2) Such 置首後同樣動詞在主詞前：Such was his courage that…；(3) 後面接 that 結果子句。防第二正解：distractor 用未倒裝（主詞在動詞前）、what 代 that、so/such 誤用、漏冠詞鎖唯一解。皆標準英語，以 Swan/Oxford，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: So/Such … that 倒裝（So beautiful was the view that… / Such was his anger that…）
units.can_do: 我能為了強調，把 So ＋ 形容詞/副詞 或 Such 放到句首而引發倒裝，把動詞（通常 be）移到主詞前，再接 that 結果子句：So beautiful was the view that everyone stopped.／Such was his anger that he could not speak.。
units.situation_group: 特殊句型 Fronted So/Such for emphasis
units.subject: eng

claims.text: When 'So + adjective/adverb' is fronted for emphasis, the verb (usually 'be') comes before the subject: 'So beautiful was the view that everyone stopped.' (= The view was so beautiful that everyone stopped.)
claims.verification_ref: So ＋ 形容詞/副詞置首強調時，動詞（通常 be）移到主詞前；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When 'Such' is fronted, the verb also comes before the subject: 'Such was his anger that he could not speak.' (= His anger was such that he could not speak.)
claims.verification_ref: Such 置首時動詞同樣移到主詞前；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: This emphatic pattern is followed by a 'that' clause that shows the result: 'So + adjective + be + subject + that + result'; use 'that', not 'what'.
claims.verification_ref: 此強調句型後接 that 結果子句（用 that 非 what）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After the fronted 'So + adjective,' the order is verb + subject, not subject + verb: 'So cold was it that the lake froze,' not 'So cold it was that...'
claims.verification_ref: So ＋ 形容詞置首後語序為動詞＋主詞，非主詞＋動詞；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To add emphasis, we can move 'So + an adjective or adverb' to the front of the sentence. When we do, the verb (usually 'be') comes before the subject: So beautiful was the view that everyone stopped to take photos.
teach.zh_hint: 為了加強語氣，我們可以把 So ＋ 形容詞或副詞 移到句首。這時動詞（通常是 be）要放到主詞前面：So beautiful was the view that everyone stopped to take photos.（景色是如此美麗，大家都停下來拍照。＝The view was so beautiful that…）

teach.body: So loud was the music that we could not hear each other.
teach.zh_hint: 音樂是如此大聲，我們彼此都聽不見。So loud 置首，be 動詞 was 移到主詞 the music 前。

teach.body: We can also front 'Such'. Again the verb comes before the subject: Such was his anger that he could not speak. Notice the word order is verb + subject, not subject + verb.
teach.zh_hint: 我們也可以把 Such 放到句首。同樣地，動詞要放到主詞前：Such was his anger that he could not speak.（他是如此憤怒，以致於說不出話。）注意語序是「動詞＋主詞」，不是「主詞＋動詞」。

teach.body: Such was her kindness that everyone trusted her at once.
teach.zh_hint: 她是如此善良，每個人立刻就信任她。Such 置首，was 移到主詞 her kindness 前。

teach.body: This emphatic pattern is followed by a 'that' clause showing the result: So + adjective + be + subject + that + result. Use 'that', not 'what'.
teach.zh_hint: 這個強調句型後面要接 that 結果子句：So ＋ 形容詞 ＋ be ＋ 主詞 ＋ that ＋ 結果。連接詞用 that，不是 what。

teach.body: So difficult was the test that many students failed it.
teach.zh_hint: 考試是如此困難，許多學生都不及格。So difficult 置首、was the test 倒裝、後接 that 結果子句。

practice.stem: 選出正確的倒裝：So loud ____ that we covered our ears.（音樂是如此大聲）

distractor_rationales.the music was: So ＋ 形容詞置首後語序是「動詞＋主詞」；主詞在動詞前就沒倒裝。
distractor_rationales.did the music: 這裡的動詞是 be（was），不借助 do；應為 was the music。
distractor_rationales.was music: music 前需要冠詞 the（the music）；漏了冠詞。

practice.feedback: So ＋ 形容詞置首、be 移到主詞前：So loud was the music that…

practice.stem: 選出正確的倒裝：Such ____ that everyone admired him.（他的勇氣是如此之大）

distractor_rationales.his courage was: Such 置首後語序是「動詞＋主詞」；主詞在動詞前就沒倒裝。
distractor_rationales.was courage his: his 是所有格，要放在名詞前（his courage），不是 courage his。
distractor_rationales.did his courage: 動詞是 be（was），不借助 do；應為 was his courage。

practice.feedback: Such 置首、be 移到主詞前：Such was his courage that…

practice.answer: So difficult was the test that many students failed.
options: So difficult was the test that many students failed.
So difficult the test was that many students failed.
So difficult was the test what many students failed.
So difficult was the test, many students failed.

distractor_rationales.So difficult the test was that many stud: So ＋ 形容詞置首後要倒裝（was the test），這句主詞在動詞前。
distractor_rationales.So difficult was the test what many stud: 結果子句用連接詞 that，不是 what。
distractor_rationales.So difficult was the test, many students: 缺連接詞 that；此句型必須接 that 結果子句。

practice.feedback: 倒裝＋that 結果子句：So difficult was the test that many students failed.

practice.stem: 選出正確的倒裝：So ____ that she won the first prize.（她是如此有才華）

distractor_rationales.she was talented: 此格要填 So 之後的部分；主詞在動詞前，沒有倒裝。
distractor_rationales.talented she was: So talented 置首後要倒裝為「動詞＋主詞」（was she），不是 she was。
distractor_rationales.was she talented: 形容詞 talented 應緊接 So（So talented…），不能把 talented 丟到最後變成疑問語序。

practice.feedback: So talented 置首、be 移到主詞前：So talented was she that…

practice.answer: Such was his kindness that everyone trusted him.
options: Such was his kindness that everyone trusted him.
Such his kindness was that everyone trusted him.
Such was his kindness what everyone trusted him.
So was his kindness that everyone trusted him.

distractor_rationales.Such his kindness was that everyone trus: Such 置首後要倒裝為「動詞＋主詞」（was his kindness），這句沒倒裝。
distractor_rationales.Such was his kindness what everyone trus: 結果子句用 that，不是 what。
distractor_rationales.So was his kindness that everyone truste: kindness 是名詞，前面要用 Such 不是 So（So 接形容詞/副詞）。

practice.feedback: 名詞用 Such 置首、倒裝、接 that：Such was his kindness that everyone trusted him.

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀＋語調模仿：看句子朗讀→自評（不自動判讀發音）。置首 So/Such 與形容詞加重、略停頓，倒裝的 be ＋ 主詞連讀，that 結果子句句尾下收。

lines.text: So beautiful was the sunset that we forgot the time.
lines.intonation: So beautiful 加重、was the sunset 連讀、that 子句句尾下收

lines.text: Such was his patience that the children loved his class.
lines.intonation: Such 加重、was his patience 連讀、that 子句句尾下收
